agents.name: Bob
memories: Water is the constraint that ends farms.
Do not plant more than we can water.

today.why: The row is in the ground now. Clear sky will pull moisture under twenty if we wait, and a farm that cannot water what it planted is the one that ends.
today.expect: East field wet enough that the sprout holds through another clear day.

yesterday.why: Pond is full and field moisture is low.
yesterday.expect: Cistern high enough to irrigate if the sky stays clear.

agents.name: Alice
memories: Unused seeds are a delay, not a reserve.
Ditches compound. Heat does not wait.

today.why: Ditches compound and heat does not wait. A cut today means every watering after this holds longer.
today.expect: An irrigation ditch so the field stops bleeding moisture on clear days.

yesterday.why: Moisture is low, but seeds in the sack grow nothing.
yesterday.expect: A planted row that rain or irrigation can catch.
